title: Tencent opens Hy4 — 770B weights, 49B working
summary: Tencent’s Apache-licensed Hy4 Preview separates a 770-billion-parameter backbone from 49 billion active parameters per token, then uses sparse-index reuse to make million-token attention less costly. The listener’s other locked dives trace a national tally of local data-center pauses and Debian’s decision to permit responsible generative-AI use while leaving every contribution on the submitter, followed by Sunday’s synthesis of what the week established.

threads.name: AI sovereignty and open weights
threads.status: Tencent released Apache-licensed Hy4 Preview with 770B headline parameters, 49B active per token, a one-million-token context, and an official multi-accelerator serving recipe, widening the gap between downloadable weights and workstation-scale local deployment.
threads.arc: The thread moves from who owns the distribution point and inference engine to what operational independence means when permissively licensed weights still require machine-room infrastructure.

threads.name: Data-center buildout backlash
threads.status: A National League of Cities tracker now counts at least 76 local attempts at data-center moratoriums or permanent bans, most successful, while Cary approved an 18-month pause to write rules around power, water, noise, and site design.
threads.arc: The thread moves from individual county pauses and load-disclosure rules to a quantified national pattern of local governments buying time before approving the next facility.

repeat_coverage.story: National data-center moratorium tally and Cary’s pause
repeat_coverage.new_development: The National League of Cities tracker adds the first national tally in this thread—at least 76 local attempts, most successful—and Cary adds a new 18-month regional pause.

dives.why_it_matters: Teams evaluating open-weight infrastructure need to separate ownership of the weights from the hardware needed to operate them, and Hy4 shows how expert routing, sparse attention, cross-layer index reuse, and multi-token prediction attack four different serving costs.

dives.story: The national spread of local data-center moratoriums
dives.why_it_matters: Anyone siting compute or planning grid capacity now has evidence that local permitting delay is a repeatable national constraint, with moratoria buying time to write concrete rules for power, water, noise, and site design.

Open-source maintainers deciding how to govern AI-assisted work now have a flagship project’s enforceable model: keep one quality bar, attach liability to the submitter, draw hard lines around secrets and mass automation, and leave disclosure voluntary.

concepts_taught: cross-layer sparse-index reuse in long-context attention: a lightweight indexer chooses the top prior positions for sparse attention, but because that indexer remains quadratic and adjacent layers often choose similar positions, IndexCache keeps indexers only on selected full layers and lets most shared layers reuse the nearest full layer’s indices
